info.name: ChoreStrike
info.summary: Gamified household task management - Defend your home base together!
info.description:
ChoreStrike transforms household chores into a cooperative tower defense game.
**Features:** - 🏠 Organize tasks by rooms and floors - 📅 Smart scheduling with flexible planning options - 🎮 Gamification: Defend against "The Dust" invasion - 👥 Multi-user support with leaderboards - 🏆 Team bonuses and weekly medals - 🌍 Multilingual (German, English, more to come) - 📊 Track progress with House Health system
Keep your home clean by completing tasks and watch cute pixel monsters disappear. No game over - just different levels of chaos vs. order. Perfect for families and roommates!
info.author: ChoreStrike Contributors
